says: A huge, top-heavy brawler: small blocky bald head, heavy brow, neck as wide as his jaw, giant shoulders and forearms, big hands, legs shorter than his torso suggests. Grey tank top and grey shorts, barefoot. Faceted low-poly.

body._doc: MPFB (MakeHuman) macros, 0..1. These make a real human body, so anatomy stays correct.

shape._doc: MPFB detail targets, 0..1 weight each. Names are the target files under MPFB data/targets.

stylise._doc: Cartoon proportions on top of the real body, as Rigify bone scales (1 = real anatomy). girth scales across the bone, length along it. Children inherit (a bigger forearm also means a bigger hand).

pose._doc: Degrees. Arms hang this far off vertical; elbows bend forward this much.

outfit._doc: Cloth as a thin shell over the skin, cut at body landmarks so hems are clean. Landmarks come from the Rigify bones: waist = top of the lower spine (DEF-spine.001 head), mid_thigh = where the thigh's two deform bones meet, chest = DEF-spine.003 head, neck_base = top of the shoulders (DEF-shoulder heads; his neck bone starts inside the trapezius). Arms and hands are never cloth.

lowpoly._doc: Decimate collapse ratio of the ~13k-face body, then flat shading.

eye_guess_notes.head: Head looks smaller against a much wider shoulder span than brute 1 -> 0.72.
eye_guess_notes.neck_girth: Huge trapezius slopes straight from the jaw to the deltoids, neck reads wider than brute 1 -> 1.45.
eye_guess_notes.upper_arm_girth: Upper arms and deltoids are clearly bulkier than brute 1's -> 1.2.
eye_guess_notes.forearm_girth: Forearms are heavy and widen toward the wrist, a bit thicker than brute 1 -> 1.1.
eye_guess_notes.forearm_length: Forearm-to-upper-arm ratio looks about the same, maybe slightly longer -> 0.95.
eye_guess_notes.hand: Clenched fists are big but read a little more compact than brute 1's open hands -> 1.4.
eye_guess_notes.thigh_girth: Thighs are somewhat fuller with visible quad mass -> 1.1.
eye_guess_notes.shin_girth: Shins still taper thin but slightly more calf than brute 1 -> 0.85.
eye_guess_notes.leg_length: Legs are about equal to crotch-to-shoulder height, longer relative to torso than brute 1 -> 0.88.
eye_guess_notes.foot: Feet are noticeably longer and splayed compared with brute 1 -> 0.9.
eye_guess_notes.arm_drop_from_vertical: Arms hang further out to clear the wider lats and deltoids -> 22 deg.
eye_guess_notes.elbow_bend: Slight visible forward bend at the elbows, more than brute 1's nearly straight arms -> 8 deg.
eye_guess_notes.torso/torso-scale-depth-incr: Front view only; chest looks as deep as brute 1, no evidence to change -> 1.8.
eye_guess_notes.torso/torso-muscle-dorsi-incr: Strong V-taper, lats flare well beyond the narrow waist -> 1.5.
eye_guess_notes.torso/torso-muscle-pectoral-incr: Pecs are larger and more defined under the tank top -> 1.8.
eye_guess_notes.torso/measure-shoulder-dist-incr: Shoulder span is wider relative to hips than brute 1 -> 1.6.
